brief: Group array entries by a key
description: Call callbackfn once for each entry of array, in index order, and return a new object with a property for each key it returned, whose value is an array of the entries that got that key, in order. Properties are in the order their keys first appeared. The key must be a string; it is not converted (write to_string(v) for another data type).

parameters.description: The array to walk. A string is not walked as an array: write [...value] to walk its characters.
parameters.name: array

parameters.dataTypeParameter: (value: any, index?: integer, array?: array) => string
parameters.description: Returns the key, a string, of the group the entry goes in. A script function is called with (value, index, array); a built-in function is called with the value alone, since its other parameters have their own meanings.
parameters.name: callbackfn

returns.description: A new object of arrays, one property per key.

errorsThrown.reason: callbackfn returned something other than a string
